segments.title: THE RISKS
segments.say: Zim stocks, part four of four. The risks most people skip, and the checklist to protect yourself. The risks. This is the part most people skip, and it's the most important.

segments.title: ONE DAY'S SWINGS
segments.sub: Price change in a single session, 19 Nov 2026
segments.note: Data: AfricanFinancials, end of day 19 Nov 2026. ZSE moves are in ZWG terms.
segments.say: Risk one: volatility. In a single day, the 19th of November, CBZ jumped 14 percent, while RioZim fell almost 15 and ZSE Holdings nearly 11. Prices can swing hard, in both directions.

segments.title: MORE RISKS
segments.note: Data: AfricanFinancials, end of day 19 Nov 2026. ZSE moves are in ZWG terms. Settlement times as found; confirm with your broker.

items.text: ZSE counters with zero trades on 19 Nov
items.sub: low liquidity: hard to sell quickly
as I found out, around 2 to 3 days

segments.say: Risk two: liquidity. On that same day, 15 of the 34 ZSE counters didn't trade at all. When you want to sell, there may be no buyer. Trades also take a few days to settle. Risk three: currency. ZSE prices are in ZiG, so your dollar value can change even if the share doesn't. And risk four: policy. Taxes and rules can change with each budget.

segments.title: YOUR CHECKLIST

items.text: Only invest money you won't need soon

segments.say: So, your checklist. Only invest money you won't need soon. Spread it across several companies. Read their results and announcements. Use licensed brokers only. And think in years, not days.
